title: Time-Aware Validation of Machine Learning Fuel Consumption Models: Evidence from 1\,Hz Operational Data, CCGS \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier}
abstract: arXiv:2608.16833v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ship fuel consumption (SFC) prediction supports vessel operation optimisation, emissions estimation, and decision support systems (DSS) for sustainable maritime transportation. Numerous data-driven fuel models have been developed over the past two decades, but a critical and often overlooked limitation lies in their validation practices: most studies evaluate performance using random train--test splits, which, applied to high-frequency records, admit temporal leakage and yield optimistic results that do not reflect deployment conditions. This paper examines that gap using time-aware evaluation, specifically Time Series Cross-Validation (TSCV) and Blocked TSCV (BTSCV). translated_title: 时间感知的机器学习燃油消耗模型验证：来自1Hz运行数据、CCGS《威尔弗里德·劳里尔爵士》号的证据
translated_abstract: 船舶燃油消耗（SFC）预测支持船舶运营优化、排放估算和可持续海上运输的决策支持系统（DSS）。过去二十年中开发了许多数据驱动的燃油模型，但其验证实践中存在一个关键且常被忽视的局限：大多数研究使用随机训练-测试划分来评估性能，这应用于高频记录时，会引入时间泄漏，并产生不能反映部署条件的乐观结果。本文通过时间感知评估，特别是时间序列交叉验证（TSCV）和分块TSCV（BTSCV），来检验这一差距。以加拿大海岸警卫队船舶（CCGS）《威尔弗里德·劳里尔爵士》号为案例研究，六种回归模型和一个物理基线在三种时间感知方案和三种特征配置下进行调优，然后在从1Hz运行数据中抽取的公共时间顺序保留集上进行评估。
tldr: 本文通过时间感知验证方法（TSCV和BTSCV）揭示了传统随机划分在船舶燃油消耗模型评估中的时间泄漏问题，并以实际船舶数据证明该方法能更真实地反映部署性能。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals temporal leakage issues in traditional random splits for ship fuel consumption model evaluation through time-aware validation methods (TSCV and BTSCV), demonstrating more realistic deployment performance using real ship data.
